Package com.example.cab302assignment.model

Class RedactionRule

java.lang.Object
com.example.cab302assignment.model.RedactionRule
public class RedactionRule extends Object
Represents a single rule used by the redaction engine to identify and mask sensitive data. A rule defines a regular expression pattern to search for, the type of data it represents, and how the redacted text should be formatted when a match is found. * Note: Many accessor/mutator methods were initially included to support planned future functionality for manager-controlled ruleset customisation. This feature will not be completed at this current stage. Currently, these rules are evaluated in-memory using a hardcoded default ruleset.

    • RedactionRule

      public RedactionRule()
      Default constructor required for database operations and serialization. (Planned functionality for custom database rulesets).

    • RedactionRule

      public RedactionRule(String name, String regexPattern, SensitiveDataType dataType, boolean enabled, String placeholderFormat)
      Constructs a new RedactionRule.
      Parameters:
      name - The descriptive name of the rule (e.g., "Australian Medicare Number").
      regexPattern - The regular expression used to find matches in the text.
      dataType - The categorical type of sensitive data this rule detects.
      enabled - Whether this rule is currently active in the engine.
      placeholderFormat - The string format used to replace detected text (e.g., "[MEDICARE-{index}]").

    • RedactionRule
